title: Harness compatibility configuration schema
description: Validation schema for conf/harness.conf.yaml: the harness versions the framework supports (core spec, Harness compatibility). The fail-fast configuration load refuses an installed harness version outside `require`.

require.description: A PEP 440 version specifier set, e.g. ">=1.0.0a1,<1.1". The installed harness version is read as a PEP 440 version.
